# About Me
:::

I'm a Computer Science student at Brigham Young University Idaho, with an expected graduation of December 2027 and an emphasis in Software Engineering and Cyber Security.

My professional background includes technical support and systems work, from diagnosing software and hardware issues as a Classroom Technology Technician to providing Tier-2 support and translating technical requirements for non-technical users in a previous role. I've also led teams and coordinated logistics in a full-time capacity, which has strengthened my communication and leadership skills alongside my technical work.
